pages: The fictional Aurora battery project stores 24 megawatt-hours of energy. Aurora uses lithium iron phosphate (LFP) cells. Its funding program is the fictional Green Storage Grant.

Aurora's limitations include temperature-sensitive performance and gradual capacity degradation. Its maintenance inspection interval is 90 days. Battery containers use smoke sensors and thermal monitoring.

documents.name: fleet_report.pdf
pages: The fictional Meridian fleet uses the MF4 telemetry format for GPS logs. The pipeline uses DBSCAN clustering to separate driving contexts. Processing time fell from sixty minutes to fifteen minutes.
Meridian's average daily energy use is 120 kilowatt-hours per vehicle. Its maintenance inspection interval is 30 days. Fleet safety checks include brake inspection and tire pressure checks.
